# ghost/noice

Noice ambient sounds (no account): list presets and sounds, play a preset for a few seconds then stop, stop playback.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/noice
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/noice list_presets --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/noice list_sounds --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/noice play_preset --device <serial> --param preset=<preset>
ghost skill run ghost/noice stop_playback --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `list_presets`: What sound presets do I have in Noice?
- `list_sounds`: Which ambient sounds can Noice play?
- `play_preset`: Play the Beach preset for a few seconds
- `stop_playback`: Stop the ambient sounds
